title: Geometrical approach and topological electron density in the $p_x + ip_y$ superconductor
summary: We present an analysis on the geometrical and physical nature of the $p_x + ip_y$ superconductor on the square lattice, with an emphasis on the topological phase transition at half-filling. We develop a local topological marker from specific Dirac points within the Brillouin zone, which is introduced via the addition of two one-dimensional (1D) $\mathbb{Z}$ $(\mathbb{Z}_2$) invariants defined on the Bloch sphere.
